title: Moving one customer says "1 customer moved"
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop moves the only customer on a term of its own to Net 45.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • The shop's own term {Term-A}, due 20 days after the invoice date, is held by exactly one customer, {Customer-A}.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-09 N20, {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-09 Solo.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Choose "Net 45" in "Move To".
  4. Click "Move 1 Customer".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: a window titled "Move Customers from {Term-A}" opens.
  • Step 3: the button reads "Move 1 Customer".
  • Step 4: the toast reads "1 customer moved to Net 45."

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • S4-R9: “On confirm, each ticked customer's credit term changes to the chosen term, the window closes, the page's Customers counts update, and a success toast shows "{n} customers moved to {term}." ("1 customer moved to {term}." for one).”
  • S4-R2: “The window shows, top to bottom: a "Search customers" box; "Select All" and "Select None" with "{n} selected" on the right; a scrolling list of every customer on the term, A to Z, each with a checkbox; a "Move To" dropdown; and the buttons "Cancel" and "Move {n} Customers" ("Move 1 Customer" when one is selected).”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Customers moved | "{n} customers moved to {term}." / "1 customer moved to {term}." | Success toast”
